rationale: ACID compliance in a local SQLite file is extremely clean and functional.
Encapsulating JSON parsing inside SQLAlchemy models provides clean OOP mapping.
SQLite transactions guarantee write safety and prevent concurrency bugs natively.
Declarative schemas mapped to SQLite tables align with declarative models.
Dynamic loading of JSON sub-elements is fully supported by Python/SQLite.
Zero external dependencies makes auditing and deployment extremely simple.
Eliminating MongoDB/TinyDB complexity is exactly what we advocated for.
Selected Unified SQLite for native ACID and maximum simplicity.
